name: component-moist-air-moist-air-cannot-connect-to-dry-thermofluid
source:
COMPONENT DrySink(in)
  PARAM P
  in.P = P
END
MoistAirSource SRC(P=101325, T=300, W=0.008, mdot=1)
DrySink        SNK(P=101325)
connect(SRC.out, SNK.in)

error.message: connect(src.out, snk.in): cannot connect a 'moistair' line (src.out) to a 'fluid' line (snk.in). Thermofluid ('fluid'), liquid ('liquid'), two-phase ('twophase'), pneumatic ('gas'), hydraulic ('oil') and humid-air ('moistair') are incompatible fluid connector types; couple them only through a heat exchanger.
